description:
## Original Description
Follow-up to the completed jev-advisory-toggle spec (whose approved artifacts must not be edited). Goal 1: the sdd-jev-check B1 (security) and B2 (principles) checks gain an optional, strictly validated baseRef input so they can review already-committed branch diffs (merge-base(baseRef, HEAD)..HEAD, optionally plus working-tree changes), while the no-baseRef uncommitted behaviour stays exactly unchanged and all existing guarantees remain (code opt-in SDD_JEV_ALLOW_CODE, default-off toggle + SDD_JEV_API_KEY, redaction before clip, ±15-line excerpts, 8 KB cap, exclusions including symlink targets, sidecar binding by revision/SHA-256 with stale ignored, answered-not-overwritten-by-unavailable, advisory only, no spec.json changes, zero side effects when disabled/no-key, read-only git via GitPort, baseRef validated with no option injection and resolved via git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options <ref>^{commit}). Committed-diff sidecars are bound to baseCommit+headCommit+diff hash; sdd-commit warning lookup keeps matching staged diffs. sdd-review and sdd-security-check Skill text (within 4,000-byte limits), docs, tool input schema and inventory/schema tests are updated. Goal 2: the JEV score scale is definitively zero-based: remove the one-based inferred fallback in JevResponseValidator and related code, accept only integer 0..levels-1, anything else is invalid-response; remove uncertainty notes from code comments, tests and docs; bump QUESTION_SET_VERSION if sidecar semantics change.

## Core Features (What)
1) Optional baseRef input on sdd-jev-check for B1 security and B2 principles reviewing merge-base(baseRef, HEAD)..HEAD committed diffs; 2) strict baseRef validation (reject leading '-', whitespace, control chars; resolve via git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options <ref>^{commit}) with no git side effects on rejection; 3) committed-diff sidecars bound to baseCommit+headCommit+diff SHA-256, stale ones ignored, sdd-commit lookup still matching staged diffs; 4) zero-based-only JEV score validation (integer 0..levels-1, else invalid-response) with the one-based inference and uncertainty notes removed; 5) Skill text (sdd-review, sdd-security-check), docs, tool schema and inventory/schema tests updated. Editing approved artifacts in .spec/specs/jev-advisory-toggle/; changing no-baseRef uncommitted behaviour; changing other JEV checks beyond the score-scale rule; writing git state (fetch, checkout, etc.); making JEV results blocking; spec.json changes from JEV; sdd-commit matching committed-diff sidecars.

## Success Criteria
Tests cover committed diff with baseRef, invalid baseRef rejected with zero git side effects, unchanged no-baseRef behaviour, committed-diff sidecar binding, and zero-based-only validation; full test suite passes except the known pre-existing compiled-cli.e2e cancellation failure; lint reports 0 errors; typecheck and build pass; Skill files stay within 4,000 bytes.
